references.text: Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, is mentioned as one of the spies sent out from the tribe of Judah.
God promises that Caleb will inherit the land because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly—the same reason given in Joshua 14:14.
Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, is mentioned as one who followed the Lord wholeheartedly, along with Joshua.
The promise that Caleb will receive the land he has walked on because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Caleb's speech to Joshua where he reminds him of the promise Moses gave him and asks to receive Hebron as his inheritance.
Caleb receives Hebron as his inheritance and drives out the three sons of Anak from there.
Confirms that the fields and villages of Hebron were given to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as his possession.
Hebron was given to Caleb, just as Moses had said, and he drove out the three sons of Anak from there.
